name: acadex-platform
description: AcadeX — Intelligent Examination Hall Management Platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run dev:backend
scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && npm run start:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
